1. What you are buying

Groundwork by Able offers a one-time pre-purchase of future standard individual Groundwork membership access. It does not provide immediate paid-app access, establish a recurring subscription, authorize storage of a payment method for future charging, or grant access to Groundwork Advanced, Assets & Inventory, Marketplace, or other unreleased features. Groundwork Lite, the public tools, and the customer tour are separate.

One-time purchaseBase price before applicable taxPurchased service
One-month standard Groundwork pre-purchase$9.99 USDOne paid month
Twelve-month standard Groundwork pre-purchase$96.00 USDTwelve paid months

Applicable tax, if required, is displayed separately before payment. Stripe processes the checkout; Groundwork does not collect card numbers or CVC. Each purchase is one payment only. No automatic renewal is authorized by purchasing either offer.

2. Expected delivery and complimentary time

The official target for opening the paid Groundwork application is January 1, 2027. This is a target, not proof that access is already usable. If the application is verified ready for an earlier founders' preview on or after December 14, 2026, eligible advance purchasers may be invited into complimentary preview access; earlier access is conditional and must not be advertised as guaranteed.

For advance purchases whose usable purchased membership actually begins on January 1, 2027:

  • One-month buyer: The initial $9.99 payment covers January 1–31, 2027. February 1–28 is an additional complimentary month. Any subsequent paid membership would require a new, separate authorization and could start no earlier than March 1, 2027.
  • Twelve-month buyer: The $96 payment covers January 2027 (purchased month 1) plus March 2027 through January 2028 (purchased months 2–12). February 2027 is an additional complimentary month, not one of the twelve purchased months. Access through this original schedule ends January 31, 2028. Any new paid period would require separate authorization and could start no earlier than February 1, 2028.

The conditional December preview does not consume a purchased month or February bonus. If verified usable purchased access starts later than January 1, the full purchased period and one additional complimentary month must be preserved; unavailable days do not count as delivered service. The exact revised dates are provided to the buyer when access is confirmed, based on the then-approved service-calendar rules.

OPEN BEFORE PUBLICATION: The engineering calendar for delayed and mid-month activation must be verified, and the specific method by which a buyer receives and confirms usable access must be settled. This draft must not be presented as a guarantee of operational fulfillment.

3. Launch delay and final resolution of an undelivered purchase

When a delay becomes likely, we will notify affected buyers promptly using their purchase contact information, explain the situation, and provide the option to request a full pre-activation refund.

The approved planning communication schedule calls for a factual readiness update on December 18, 2026, a notice on January 1, 2027 if the paid application cannot open as targeted, and an unresolved-order follow-up on January 8, 2027.

January 15, 2027 is a customer-resolution cutoff, not a postponed application launch date. By that date, every as-yet-undelivered pre-purchase must have one of the following outcomes: usable purchased access delivered; the purchaser's affirmative agreement to a specific new delivery date; or cancellation with a full refund initiated within five business days of the January 15 cutoff. Customer silence does not constitute agreement to delay. A buyer who affirmatively accepts a specific later date retains the option to request a full refund before paid access begins.

Where applicable law imposes earlier or additional remedies, those requirements apply.

4. Refunds and cancellation

Before usable paid access begins: You can request cancellation and a full refund of the pre-purchase, including any legally refundable applicable tax. Complimentary preview access does not exhaust this right.

First seven calendar days after your purchased paid membership actually begins: You can request a full voluntary refund. The seven-day window does not start during complimentary December preview access or solely because an email was sent.

After the seven-day window:

  • For a $96 annual pre-purchase, voluntary cancellation provides $8 before applicable tax adjustments for each entirely unused future purchased month. A partially used purchased month is not included in this ordinary voluntary calculation. February's complimentary month does not count as a paid month.
  • For a $9.99 monthly pre-purchase, there is ordinarily no voluntary partial refund for already-used time after the initial seven days.

Non-delivery, defects in service, disputes and non-waivable statutory rights may require other refunds or remedies. A cancellation never authorizes another automatic charge.

To request a refund or ask about an order, email billing@groundworkbyable.com and provide your purchase reference and contact email; do not send payment card numbers or CVC. Refunds are made to the original payment method where supported. A refund being initiated or marked pending is not proof that the customer's bank has received the funds.

Founder-approved general refund processing standard (planning only): For an eligible refund request, Able Systems will initiate the refund through the payment processor within five business days after the request is received and the customer/order has been verified. This initiation deadline is different from the seven calendar days after paid-term commencement during which a voluntary full refund may be requested. Initiating the refund is not the same as bank receipt; provider and bank processing may take longer. Requests needing fraud, dispute, tax, or identity resolution require documented, prompt handling rather than an indefinite unrecorded hold.

OPEN BEFORE PUBLICATION: Verification and intake procedures, treatment of unclaimed access, tax-adjustment handling, legally mandated remedies and operational capacity are still subject to review. This approved planning standard has not been published as an effective customer commitment.

5. Purchase confirmation, access and support

After a verified payment, customers must receive accurate confirmation of the one-time offer, amount and any applicable taxes, the purchased term, refund/contact instructions, and the status of future access. A payment receipt or browser redirect does not prove the application is available or a membership is activated.

Activation instructions must be sent when usable access is verified. Promotional messages and optional SMS require separate appropriate consent; buying a pre-purchase does not authorize marketing texts.

  • Billing, payments, refunds, and cancellations: billing@groundworkbyable.com
  • Account assistance: support@groundworkbyable.com
  • General inquiries: hello@groundworkbyable.com

These addresses are aliases sharing an underlying mailbox. Billing delivery was founder-reported tested on November 14, 2026; formal support operations, case tracking, and customer-notification delivery are not yet verified.

Stripe processes hosted checkout payments. Able Systems may retain limited purchase identifiers, paid amounts and taxes, dates, the accepted terms version, fulfillment status, and records necessary to support refunds, disputes and applicable recordkeeping. The published Privacy Policy must accurately explain this processing before checkout is offered.
